Title: Soul Gem of Etrius vs Temptation and Corruption (LSJ)

Messages.Author: Richard Labrecque, aka Khaleph Alendis
Messages.Body:
The situation :

Justine, Elder of Dallas is now with a Fortitude
discipline card and is equiped with the Soul Gem of Etrius.

Justine is also with a Temptation and 5 Corruption counter on her.

Now, Justine is burned in combat and the controler of
Justine draw a card from his crypt. The vampire is
Justine, without the Fortitude discipline. That
younger Justine comes into play at maximum capacity
and inherits the Soul Gem of Etrius.

My question :

Did the Temptation card and the Corruption Counter are on
the new incarnation of Justine ?

I suppose that the answer is no, but I would like to have a confirmation.

Bye,

Richard Labrecque, aka Khaleph Alendis
